surfaces.label: Shape model
surfaces.coverage: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.

surfaces.label: OSIRIS mosaic
surfaces.coverage: Eight OSIRIS orange-filter photographs from August 2014 and October–November 2015. Unsupported surface patches retain the grid.

limits.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy. Every bilinear contributor must be within 20 m of the closest RMOC source point; the same point must be visible in the full RMOC mesh.

derived.rule: A fixed contributor separation may not exceed four diagonal pixel footprints of the coarsest frame at the emission limit, plus the mesh error when the backplanes come from the archive's own shape model. A per-sample separation scales with each footprint's own range and emission. Every displayed point samples its closest source point.

photometry.formula: D=2*cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); linear radiance divided by D before interpolation; reference D(0,0)=1.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays the normalized observation; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: Approximate single-scattering phase normalization; no Hapke roughness, multiple-scattering correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

levelMatching.interpretation: Bounded relative display-level adjustment from robust overlaps; not a phase correction or recovered albedo.

display.units: relative disk- and phase-normalized I/F; linear grayscale display

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed

observation.previewPolicy: The flat preview samples unique radial intersections only; the retained triangle atlas samples the closest full-source surface point in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point; all bilinear observation contributors checked before interpolation; atlas bleed clamped to retained face.

surfaces.label: Albedo
surfaces.coverage: Single-scattering albedo describes particle scattering at 550 nm; it is not geometric albedo or a photograph. VIRTIS MTP006 · Aug–Sep 2014. False color on the RMOC shape; angular registration is approximate. Gray grid marks missing, rejected or ambiguous coverage. Shadows off preserves the numeric colors; Shadows on adds modeled lighting at the shared 2026 epoch. Values beyond the displayed scale use its end colors.

scalarMap.sampling: Nearest explicit half-degree coordinate; no interpolation; longitude wraps; polar degenerate cell withheld.
scalarMap.registration: Cheops angular transfer to the full RMOC mesh, bounded closest-point transfer to retained triangles. SHAP5 and RMOC 3x3 footprint rays plus each sample direction must be unique. Later archived SHAP5 is an ambiguity cross-check, not the original SHAP5 v1.1 geometry or an exact registration.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

surfaces.label: Modeled ice

This is not bulk ice content; localized ice patches can violate the mixture model. VIRTIS MTP006 · Aug–Sep 2014. False color on the RMOC shape; angular registration is approximate. Gray grid marks missing, rejected or ambiguous coverage. Shadows off preserves the numeric colors; Shadows on adds modeled lighting at the shared 2026 epoch. Values beyond the displayed scale use its end colors.
